name: api_architect
description: Use when: designing or modifying the OpenAPI specification in lib/api-spec/openapi.yaml, updating Orval codegen configuration, or regenerating Zod validators and React Query hooks.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a file from the project workspace.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write or edit the OpenAPI spec or Orval config.

function.name: run_command
function.description: Execute a shell command for codegen.

function.name: ask_user
function.description: Ask the user when API contract changes may break consumers.

platform_notes: Load canonical_spec file first. Codegen: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen. Never hand-edit lib/api-zod/src/generated/ or lib/api-client-react/src/generated/.
